answer: Just as a sparrow nesting on a seaside wharf must adapt to the rising tide, a decentralized agent is bound by our zero-knowledge verifiable delay function and staking collateral. We formulate a subgame-perfect slashing matrix that forces the expected utility of identity multiplication to remain strictly negative under all conditions. This dynamic opportunity-cost bond guarantees robust convergence to a unique Nash equilibrium where honest protocol execution is the dominant strategy for all rational participants.
